user_motivation: Reliability-gated visual-sensor-state fusion with a learned fallback for missing and degraded structured sidecars.
special_requirements: All numerical claims must be traceable to local checkpoints, predictions, and scripts.
Current sidecar provenance must be disclosed as image-conditioned estimates rather than independent hardware measurements.
The repeatedly analyzed test split must be described as an internal benchmark rather than an untouched external blind test.
Visual-only must remain identified as the strongest clean classifier overall.
LMF may be called strongest in clean Macro F1 only among evaluated three-modality fusion methods.
The class-memory probe supports class alignment, not a unique natural-language semantic advantage.
Fixed-checkpoint bypasses measure path reliance, not independently retrained module contributions.
No absent sensor hardware or acquisition parameter may be invented.
